summary.pack_description:
Brace yourself for the intensity of the lead-up to playoff hockey with Set the Tone, a captivating and brand-new compilation of body checks that highlights the value of physical play in hockey! Witness body checks that ignite team spirit and fuel intensity, all while upholding the true essence of sportsmanship in the game. Collect hit highlights from tone-setters Shea Weber, Dustin Brown, Matt Martin, Tom Wilson, David Backes, Brooks Orpik, and more! This pack includes 2 guaranteed Limited highlights and additional chances for Core, Rare, Epic, and Legendary highlights.

Each pack contains 1 Set the Tone highlight, 2 Core highlights from either Base 2024-25 (75%), or Fresh Sweaters (25%), and 1 mystery highlight that could be from Set the Tone (54.84%), Opening Ice: Elites (20%), Opening Ice 2024-25 (15%), Opening Ice: Icons (7%), Take a Bow (2%), Cause for a Celly: 2010s (1%), or Etched in Ice (0.16%)

release.name: Set the Tone Debut LE Pack
release.description:
Sale Starts: Tuesday, Feb 25 at 1pm ET / 10am PT

 

Price: $25 USD

# Packs Available: 750 packs total. Edition numbers are distributed randomly.

 

Purchase Limit: Ten (10) pack limit per person for the first 6 hours; limit increased to fifty (50) pack limit per person afterward. Once the “Buy Now” process has started, users will have 10 minutes to complete checkout before the pack(s) is released for another collector to purchase.

 

Highlights Per Pack: 4

Pack Contents (Highlight Rarity, Edition Size):

  • One (1) highlight from Set the Tone (Limited #/500)
  • Two (2) highlights with the following probabilities:
    • 75% Base 2024-25 (Core #/1500)
    • 25% Fresh Sweaters (Core #/1500)
  • One (1) highlight with the following probabilities:
    • 54.84% Set the Tone (Limited #/500) 
    • 20% Opening Ice: Elites (Rare #/250)
    • 15% Opening Ice 2024-25 (Rare #/250)
    • 7% Opening Ice: Icons (Rare #/250)
    • 2% Take a Bow (Epic #/100) 
    • 1% Cause for a Celly: 2010s (Epic #/100)
    • 0.16% Etched in Ice (Legendary #/10)



Payment Methods Accepted: Most major credit and debit cards. Payments will be made via registered payment processor MoonPay where available; where not available, payments will be processed via Stripe. Payment via cryptocurrency is also available. See these FAQs for a complete list of supported currencies.

 

Fan Marketplace: Packs and highlights are eligible to be sold to other collectors in the NHL Breakaway fan marketplace. See FAQ.

 

Transferability: Packs and highlights can be exchanged in the Trade Lounge™ with other NHL Breakaway users.

 

Blockchain: Polygon

 

Sets Included:

  • Highlights List
  • Fresh Sweaters, Series 2 - Preview
  • Base 2024-25, Series 2 - Preview
  • Set the Tone, Series 2 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: Icons, Series 2 - Preview
  • Opening Ice: Elites, Series 2 - Preview
  • Opening Ice 2024-25, Series 2 - Preview
  • Cause for a Celly: 2010s, Series 2 - Preview
  • Take a Bow, Series 2 - Preview
  • Etched in Ice, Series 2 - Preview

 

Collection Guarantee: Series 2 highlights will only be distributed during Series 2, which ends prior to the start of the 2025-26 Regular Season. We will not issue more than the edition limit we have set. Any editions not distributed in packs will not be distributed after the series end date (See FAQ for “Uncirculated Editions”)

 

All sales subject to Terms

summary.name: Set the Tone
summary.description: Introducing Set the Tone, a captivating compilation of body checks that exemplify the aspect of physical play in hockey. This Limited set celebrates the players' remarkable ability to create opportunities and shift momentum through skillfully executed hits. Witness body checks that ignite team spirit and fuel excitement, all while upholding the true essence of sportsmanship in the game. Experience the thrill of impactful plays that leave a lasting impression on fans and players alike.

summary.name: Base 2024-25
summary.description: Gear up for a season-long thrill ride with Base 2024-25! This Core set is packed with can’t-miss moments: from electrifying goals and crisp apples to heavy hits, clutch defensive plays, and jaw-dropping goalie saves. Whether it’s a game-breaking snipe, a tape-to-tape gem, or a showstopping glove save, each highlight chronicles the key plays of the 2024-25 NHL regular season.

summary.name: Fresh Sweaters
summary.description: Celebrate the excitement of a fresh start with the Fresh Sweaters Core set, featuring players making their mark with their new NHL teams. Each highlight captures a standout moment—whether it's a snipe, an apple, a great defensive play, a hit, or a jaw-dropping save. Relive the impact of players as they introduce themselves to new fans and teammates, setting the tone for the next chapter in their careers and defining their journey with a new franchise.

summary.name: Opening Ice: Elites
summary.description: Introducing Opening Ice: Elites, a Rare highlight set that captures the unforgettable moments when the game's current stars scored their first career NHL goal or a talented goalie secured his debut NHL victory. This exclusive collection showcases the raw talent and emotion of these rising stars as they etch their names in NHL history. Experience the sheer joy and determination as they find the back of the net or defend their crease in their milestone moments.

summary.name: Opening Ice 2024-25
summary.description: Collect history with Opening Ice 2024-25 Rare set. This seasonal installment chronicles the first NHL career milestones from from highly-anticipated 2024-25 rookies. Featuring first goals and first wins, these highlights capture moments these players will always remember as they forge their future in the league.

summary.name: Opening Ice: Icons
summary.description: Introducing Opening Ice: Icons, a Rare set that immortalizes the unforgettable moments when legendary players scored their first NHL goals. Relive the sheer joy and determination as these icons achieve their first milestone in the NHL. Opening Ice: Icons celebrates the origins of hockey’s great heroes and commemorates the beginnings of remarkable careers.

summary.name: Take A Bow
summary.description: Enter the realm of hockey's rich history through Take a Bow, a commemorative collection that honors revered retired players achieving career-defining milestones. These moments, which once ignited arenas with sheer excitement, range from players entering the prestigious 500-goal club, marking their 1,000th point or a goalie earning his 400th win. Take a Bow is a celebration of their lasting impact on the sport, reliving the thrills that turned them into household names. With carefully curated Epic highlights, this set captures the essence of their charisma and skill, reminding us why they remain ingrained in our hearts.

summary.name: Cause for a Celly: 2010s
summary.description: Cause for a Celly: 2010s immortalizes many unforgettable NHL playoff highlights that helped define the sport, featuring some of the game's greatest players and iconic plays that have left an indelible mark on hockey history. From stunning overtime goals to game-saving glove saves, Cause for a Celly: 2010s captures the drama, passion, and intensity of the playoffs like never before. This Epic set delves into the annals of NHL history, bringing to life the brilliance of great players and the unforgettable plays that have shaped the postseason.

summary.name: Connor McDavid
summary.description:
Entering the 2024-25 season, Connor McDavid has solidified his dominance in the NHL over nine remarkable seasons. The 3-time Hart Trophy, 5-time Art Ross Trophy, Maurice Richard Trophy, and Conn Smythe Trophy winner has accumulated 982 points, leading the league by 141 points since his debut. Known for his extraordinary skill and relentless drive, McDavid has delivered countless unforgettable plays throughout his career.  
One iconic moment occurred during the "Battle of Alberta" in the 2022 Stanley Cup Playoffs when McDavid clinched the series in Game 5 with an overtime goal, marking his first playoff overtime winner. In the 2024 Stanley Cup Playoffs, where McDavid earned the Conn Smythe Trophy, he broke Wayne Gretzky’s single playoff season assist record. A highlight from that run was his signature assist in Game 5 of the Stanley Cup Final, where he set up Corey Perry for the game winning goal. Additionally, in the Western Conference Final against Dallas, McDavid scored a sensational goal in Game 6 to clinch the series, further cementing his legacy as one of the game's all-time greats.
